Job Title: ServiceNow ITSM Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
* * * 
 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
Join our team as a ServiceNow ITSM Developer , where you’ll play a key role in shaping and enhancing our IT Service Management capabilities. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize ITSM solutions across the ServiceNow platform to improve service delivery, streamline processes, and create intuitive user experiences. If you enjoy solving problems, building efficient workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams, this is an exciting opportunity to grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.


 Responsibilities: 

 ITSM Application Development & Configuration 
 Configure and maintain core ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
 Develop and customize workflows, business rules, UI policies, and notifications.
 Create and maintain Service Catalog items, record producers, and order guides.
 Configure SLAs, assignment rules, routing, and escalation logic.
 Build and manage user groups and role-based access.
 Integrate ITSM applications with internal systems and third‑party tools.
 Service Catalog Management 
 Design user-friendly Service Catalog items and fulfillment workflows.
 Configure catalog variables, variable sets, UI policies, and approval processes.
 Develop catalog client scripts and maintain catalog categories and user criteria.
 Enhance self‑service capabilities and connect catalog items to backend systems.
 Process Automation 
 Automate workflows using Flow Designer and business rules.
 Build approval flows for Change and Request Management.
 Configure auto-assignment, workload distribution, reminders, and auto‑closure rules.
 Create scheduled jobs and system integrations as needed.
 Knowledge Management 
 Configure and maintain Knowledge Management structures, workflows, and approval processes.
 Support Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practices.
 Create templates, articles, analytics configurations, and feedback mechanisms.
 Reporting & Analytics 
 Develop reports, dashboards, and ITSM performance metrics.
 Build executive-level dashboards and support compliance reporting.
 Analyze trends and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
 Support & Maintenance 
 Troubleshoot and resolve ITSM application issues.
 Provide production support and participate in upgrades, patches, and testing.
 Document configurations, designs, and procedures.
 Train end users and support teams on new functionality.
 Collaboration 
 Partner with process owners to implement ITIL best practices.
 Work with business stakeholders to gather and refine requirements.
 Collaborate with infrastructure and development teams on integrations.
 Participate in CAB meetings and Agile ceremonies.
 Provide knowledge transfer to operational teams.
 
 
 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Certifications 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
 ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM or equivalent hands-on experience
 Technical Skills 
 Strong understanding of ServiceNow fundamentals and ITSM applications
 Familiarity with ITIL processes
 Experience with Service Catalog development and Flow Designer
 Basic JavaScript for business rules and client scripts
 Knowledge of SLA management, notifications, UI/data policies, and ACLs
 Understanding of REST/SOAP integrations
 Experience with reporting and dashboards
 Experience 
 1–3 years of ServiceNow platform experience
 Hands-on configuration of ITSM modules
 Experience developing Service Catalog workflows and automation
 Understanding of IT service delivery and support models
 Exposure to scripting within ServiceNow
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
 Active Secret Clearance
 
 Soft Skills 
 Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
 Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
 Customer-service mindset and attention to user experience
 Ability to translate requirements into scalable solutions
 Collaborative team player with a process-improvement mindset
 
 Desired: 

 Additional ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CAD, advanced ITSM certs)
 Experience with Virtual Agent, chatbot development, and IntegrationHub
 Experience with ServiceNow Mobile apps
 Familiarity with accessibility and UI/UX best practices
 Advanced scripting experience (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, etc.)


 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$75,200-$158,100 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
